profile:
COMPANY NAME: KORE Wireless
INDUSTRY: IoT Connectivity & Managed Services
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Global enterprise IoT connectivity solutions including SIM/eSIM management, connectivity management platforms, and end-to-end hardware and logistics services.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Enterprise organizations and innovators deploying IoT solutions in sectors such as asset monitoring, EV charging, connected health, fleet management, utilities, and smart agriculture.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Global and local IoT connectivity across multiple networks and technologies
- SIM and eSIM options for flexible deployment
- Integrated connectivity management platform for provisioning, monitoring, and policy control
- Hardware sourcing, in-house device testing, and certification services
- Managed services and 24/7 global support
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- End-to-end partner approach combining connectivity, hardware, and managed services
- Resilience through multi-carrier options and automatic fallbacks
- Global reach with local execution and expertise
- Proven scale with 21M+ connected devices and 20+ years of carrier relationships
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise
